name: Find member by member number
description: Looks up a member by their member number in MERIDIAN CORE, returning the member number, name and share count shown on the inquiry results row.

outputs.name: memberId
outputs.description: Member No. cell value from results row

outputs.name: memberName
outputs.description: Name cell value from results row

outputs.name: shareCount
outputs.description: Shares cell value from results row

form field name for search value, part of submission contract

locator.reason: submits the member search form

steps.description: Member No. cell value from results row

locator.reason: row in results table where first cell equals the searched member number parameter, scoped to avoid matching the search form's echoed value
positional fallback: first data row, first column of the results table

steps.description: Name cell value from results row
